recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and do not restore ComputablePlanDefinition in core. If the profile needs to be active or corrected, pursue that in the CRMI implementation guide or through a new CDS/FMG decision to bring matured profiles back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-18845 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested a ComputablePlanDefinition profile on PlanDefinition requiring PlanDefinition.library 1..1 as the principal CQL library and restricting expressions to names in that specified library.
initial_application: Commit 35c37212b7796c9ca21c377015d6b39ff06a8e0a applied the issue by adding PlanDefinition computable spreadsheet source and related CQL Library profile source; pre-removal generated/source artifacts show PlanDefinition.library constrained to 1..1 with the single-library description.
additional_context: FHIR-48393 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 decision to remove ComputablePlanDefinition and related CDS profiles from the base specification because they had moved out of core. The 2024-08-21 CDS/CQI agenda records a 17-0-0 motion to move ComputablePlanDefinition and related profiles out of base, and current core narrative tells users to use CRMI for Shareable, Publishable, Computable, and Executable profiles. The CRMI repository has a crmi-computableplandefinition source file under _unused-resources, so any remaining profile activation/publishing concern is external to core.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The current core source keeps PlanDefinition active but has an empty PlanDefinition profile pack and no ComputablePlanDefinition StructureDefinition; restoring the old profile would contradict FHIR-48393 and the current build scope. The remaining OID entry is historical metadata only.
